name: Production Distro RC13
source: RC12 final audit; maestro-managed RC13 planning
goal: Plan and execute AIOS-body local trust unblock for drift-zero artifact identity, immutable object descriptor binding, freshness and revocation authority, verified quarantine preflight, executable AgentCore PlanSpec readiness, SecurityExecution allow preconditions, exact approval, controlled activation, rollback, and support/recovery evidence.
core_thesis: AIOS becomes Ubuntu-like distributable only when every release byte is locally identified, every declared/current artifact identity is drift-zero, every fetched byte is quarantined before interpretation, and every activation or rollback effect is authorized through exact approval, AgentCore executable PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine allow, audit, rollback, and support/recovery evidence.
non_goals: Do not build mirror frontend, nginx, TLS, remote signer, object storage, or remote dispatch infrastructure in RC13 body tasks.
Do not read, copy, print, hash, move, or reference private signing material.
Do not claim GA production readiness.
Do not treat mirror reachability, signer reachability, frontend output, shell output, TUI output, model replay, object storage UI, or remote service reachability as authority.

Do not install, activate, rollback, mutate boot metadata, mutate active slots, mutate active artifact sets, mutate production rings, upload support bundles, or dispatch remote fleet actions unless a later task proves every gate and records the effect explicitly.
primary_acceptance: RC13 plan is active and task-managed with RC13-001 as the next executable task.

The plan covers drift-zero repair, object manifest descriptor binding, freshness and revocation authority, quarantine preflight, AgentCore executable PlanSpec readiness, SecurityExecution allow preconditions, canary identity enrollment, exact approval, controlled activation, rollback, support/recovery, and final audit.
The plan preserves AIOS-body-only scope and keeps mirror frontend, nginx/TLS, signer infrastructure, object storage provisioning, remote dispatch, and production ring mutation out of scope.
The plan keeps production_ready_claim=false until final audit proves every required gate.
